issues.legal_issue: Litigation expenses incurred in defending a claim arising from the conduct of the assessee’s business are revenue expenditure when they protect that business rather than create or secure a capital asset.
material_facts: Quarrying limestone was one of the assessee’s business activities, and it was working the quarry as the government’s agent when the litigation was brought.
A third party sued the government and the assessee, seeking damages from both, and the claim against the assessee arose because it was working the quarry.
The assessee defended the suit and incurred the litigation expenses; it had not initiated the proceedings.
The court inferred that the expenses were incurred to protect the assessee’s business, not to safeguard its prospects of obtaining a new lease.
issues.conclusion: The litigation expenses were revenue expenditure incurred wholly and exclusively for the purpose of the assessee’s business, and the High Court’s contrary answer was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: Expenditure attributable to acquiring or improving a fixed capital asset is capital expenditure, whereas expenditure incurred to protect or maintain the assessee’s trade or business is revenue expenditure. Under Shree Meenakshi Mills Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-Tax, Madras, 63 I.T.R. 207, the deductibility of civil-proceeding expenses depends on the nature and purpose of the proceeding in relation to the business, not its eventual outcome; expenses reasonably and honestly incurred wholly and exclusively to promote the business may be deductible even if the proceeding fails.

rule.if: litigation_expense_tax_deduction_case and assessee_carried_on_relevant_business and assessee_was_operating_property_when_sued and third_party_sought_damages_from_assessee and claim_arose_from_business_activity and assessee_defended_the_claim

predicates.litigation_expense_tax_deduction_case: The proceeding concerns whether litigation expenses qualify as a business deduction for tax purposes.
predicates.assessee_carried_on_relevant_business: The assessee carried on a business to which the disputed activity related.
predicates.assessee_was_operating_property_when_sue: The assessee was operating the relevant property when the litigation was brought.
predicates.third_party_sought_damages_from_assessee: A third party made a claim for damages against the assessee in the litigation.
predicates.claim_arose_from_business_activity: The claim against the assessee arose because of an activity it carried on in its business.
predicates.assessee_defended_the_claim: The assessee incurred the disputed expenses defending the claim rather than initiating the proceeding.

issues.definition: When a tax-deduction dispute concerns litigation expenses and the stated business and litigation facts are present, the expenses count as deductible revenue expenditure.
